findings.title: Audit evidence content is accepted without schema validation
findings.observedBehavior: The binding routine hashes and parses the snapshot but checks only auditRunId and repository.head; it never validates schemas/audit-evidence.schema.json or material provenance fields.
findings.expectedBehavior: A snapshot must conform to the current evidence schema and semantic invariants before findings bind to it.
findings.impact: A locally authored snapshot can retain the expected run ID and revision while omitting or fabricating material provenance.

evidence.description: Evidence is hashed and parsed but only run ID and revision are checked.

affectedLocations.description: The available schema is not invoked.

findings.resolution: Validate the snapshot against its schema and enforce required semantics; add malformed correctly-hashed fixtures.
verification: A correctly hashed malformed snapshot is rejected.

findings.title: Audit validators follow report paths without canonical containment checks
findings.observedBehavior: Findings evidence and schema 2.1 sourceReview paths are resolved and read without a required root, canonical containment, regular-file, or symlink check.
findings.expectedBehavior: Referenced artifacts must be regular files inside canonical repository-owned report directories with redirection rejected.
findings.impact: A crafted workspace can make validation consume bytes outside the repository or through redirected report paths.

evidence.description: Audit evidence is read without canonical containment.
Source review is read without containment or symlink checks.

findings.resolution: Require repository root, canonicalize paths, reject symlinks and non-files, and reuse containedPath.

findings.title: Verification record digests are not bound to named artifacts
findings.observedBehavior: Schema 2.2 requires evidenceSha256 but no evidence path, while semantic validation checks only that the digest string exists.
findings.expectedBehavior: Each record should identify a contained immutable artifact whose bytes, run, revision, tool, status, and scope are verified.
findings.impact: A report can claim successful provenance using any syntactically valid digest.

evidence.description: Records expose no evidence artifact path.
Record validation checks identity and presence only.

findings.resolution: Add content-addressed evidence references and validate containment, bytes, digest, identity, and scope.
verification: Arbitrary digests and missing artifacts fail.

findings.title: Digest equality contradicts the schema's case-insensitive format
findings.observedBehavior: Schemas allow uppercase hexadecimal while the validator compares the reference, filename, and computed lowercase digest case-sensitively.
findings.expectedBehavior: Schema-valid representations validate consistently, or schemas require canonical lowercase.
findings.impact: A schema-valid uppercase digest can be rejected, causing contract inconsistency and false failures.
findings.resolution: Require lowercase in schemas and writers, or normalize all digest comparisons; add uppercase fixtures.
verification: Schema and semantic validation agree for uppercase input.
